**Frozen files.** `EditorViewController.swift`, `TimelineView.swift`,
`PreviewCanvasView.swift`, `AgentServer.swift` are **frozen at current
size**: anything adding more than ~50 lines goes in an extension file
(`EditorViewController+<Feature>.swift`, `TimelineView+<Feature>.swift`,
`AgentServer+<Feature>.swift`) or a new `…SheetController`, and the frozen
file keeps only the wiring — a stored property, a closure assignment, a
validator arm, a draw call. The pieces extension files build on are therefore
internal, not private. Pitfalls: a selector declared `@objc` on an extension
needs NO forward in the frozen file (a second declaration is an error); a
command whose body sits at the foot of a non-extension feature file carries
its validator arm there too, or the item falls through to the closing
`return true`; `handleEditorCharacter`'s bare-key `switch` matches in SOURCE
order, so a bare `case "x"` goes BELOW any modified `case "x" where …`; and
`handleEditorKey` refuses while a sheet is attached, because a sheet is
window-modal and the preview panel's forwarded keys would otherwise reach
the key map behind it.

# app/CLAUDE.md — Swift app rules

Applies to everything under `app/`. Build/verification commands and the FFI
lockstep are in the root `CLAUDE.md`; the full design is
`designs/spec/` (§3–4 the UI, §7.4–7.8 the platform side; its `README.md` is
the index). The
long form of each entry below — why each file is the shape it is, and the
traps its history turned up — is `designs/adr/app-file-history.md` (the
full history, every size toll and measurement, is archived; see its
"Original" line); this file is what governs a file now. Files
are listed by family; a file with a header comment of its own carries its
detail there.

## File map

**The core's edge.**
- `ReelCore.swift` — with its `ReelCore+<Area>.swift` files, the only files
  that call `rc_*` (spec §11 CJ-8 (l)); a new wrapper goes in the file of its
  area. `ReelCore.swift` holds `ReelProject`
  (handle + lazily decoded `ProjectSnapshot`; `json`, `snapshot` and
  `planJSON` are memoised PER HANDLE, so keep handles rather than minting
  them; so is `sourceMap(_:)`, `rc_project_source_map` decoded and checked
  once per handle and clip, SR-20), timecode, snapping (export presets/sizes/settings are
  `ExportValues.swift`'s, a pure move, HDR H-1), `ReelSpeed.limits` (the
  core's speed range and audio ceiling, typed as `SpeedLimits` in
  `CoreValues.swift` — no Swift file types a speed bound), `ReelColor` (`rc_normalise_color`, G-25) and `ReelAgentSocket` (below);
  `ReelCore+MediaFiles.swift` holds the media files the core reads or writes —
  `ReelContainer` (`rc_container_*`, a WebM/Matroska file's index, #216-R), `ReelCube`,
  `ReelHDR10` (`rc_hdr10_peak`, spec §11 HD-6; `av1Peak`, `rc_hdr10_av1_peak`, HD-18;
  `stillPeak`, `rc_hdr10_still_peak`, HD-20), `ReelAV1` and `ReelWebM` (`rc_webm_*`, the
  `av1_webm` writer, spec §11 CX-15) — `ReelCore+Cursor.swift` holds `ReelCursor`
  (`rc_cursor_open`, `rc_cursor_free`: a cursor file's open, which is its check, spec
  §11 CU-9, CU-15; road map creator-jobs CU1a; and `query`, `rc_cursor_query`'s one
  JSON request, CU2, spec §11 CU-25, and the static `query(_:tracks:project:)`, the
  same call over n tracks with a project (`plan_zooms`, CU-70)) — `ReelCore+Framing.swift`
  holds `SpeakerMatch` and `ReelProject.speakerMatch` (`rc_project_speaker_match`, road map
  creator-jobs VR6b, spec §11 VR-65: the face-to-microphone match Make Vertical's sheet
  confirms) — and `ReelCore+Graphics.swift` the graphics engine's
  wrappers (below), with `ReelGraphicPackage` (`rc_graphic_package_write`, G-46; `read`,
  `rc_graphic_package_read`, G-47), `GraphicLibrary.usage()` (`rc_graphic_library_usage`)
  and `GraphicLibrary.imageCache(limit:)` (`rc_graphic_image_cache`, G-39) — both pure moves
  out of `ReelCore.swift` (road map creator-jobs CJ0d, T15); `ReelCoreError`, `Fps.ffiPair` and `ReelTime`'s
  seconds conversions are `CoreValues.swift`'s (G6 phase 5's toll T2 and speed ramps SR4-0,

  `AudioPatch`, `ClipPatch`, the `ActionPatch` extension; a pure move, B73),

  `packageContentsDidChangeOnDisk()` once — without it the next save is
  refused as "changed by another application". A folder source raises
  `.write` only and an in-place save raises nothing on it (G0 q7), so each
  module, font and asset file has its own source, up to `fileSourceLimit` (16
  a pass, modules first, then fonts, then assets, each in name order; spec §11
  G-19 (c), G-20 (a)); a source whose `open` fails is a scan warning,
  "`<subject>` is not watched: open failed (`<strerror>`)", `errno` copied
  first (G-20 (b); `GraphicScan.warnings`, shown by the Source section and `get_graphic {}`,
  G-24 (b));
  every pass re-opens every source BY PATH and
  arms BEFORE it scans; events coalesce over 100 ms. The queue owns the diff
  and an outbox; main publishes in order through `drain()` (`scan`, the
  callback, `.graphicsDidChange` with sorted names — every module and
  `library: true` when the font/asset set moved; with NO names when the
  folder holds no module and only the library moved, which still posts, G5b).

  `uniqueModuleName(_:)`, the one free-name rule (`-copy`, `-copy-N`)
  Duplicate and Insert ▸ Graphic share, which takes a name as held when the
  scan OR the disk has it (`holdsModule(named:)`, #75); `write(name:source:)`
  and `importFile` land through `land(at:writing:)`, whose `.partial` is
  removed on any failure; and `removeScratchRoot()`, which removes an untitled
  root after `stop()` — from `packageDidMove(to:)` and `stopGraphicStore()`
  (G-19 (d)). It also holds the app's delete and rename, each inside
  `onQueue` (main only, never on the store's queue) so no pass runs between
  their steps: `removeModule(named:)` keeps the file's bytes and then removes
  it, refusing when the text could not be kept, and `moveModule(from:to:)`
  moves the file, journals the pair and reads it back — a rename that cannot
  be journalled is refused — and then moves its history, a throw leaving the
  file and the history where they were and the journal put back as it was
  read (its bytes, or no file: `renameJournalBytes` / `putBackRenameJournal`

  the queue before it stores its scan, keeps the bytes a module's new text
  replaced and drops the new text's own revision, so history never holds the
  current text; nothing is kept at `start()` or for a removal the app did not

**Frozen files.** `EditorViewController.swift`, `TimelineView.swift`,
`PreviewCanvasView.swift`, `AgentServer.swift` are **frozen at current
size**: anything adding more than ~50 lines goes in an extension file
(`EditorViewController+<Feature>.swift`, `TimelineView+<Feature>.swift`,
`AgentServer+<Feature>.swift`) or a new `…SheetController`, and the frozen
file keeps only the wiring — a stored property, a closure assignment, a
validator arm, a draw call. The pieces extension files build on are therefore
internal, not private. Pitfalls: a selector declared `@objc` on an extension
needs NO forward in the frozen file (a second declaration is an error); a
command whose body sits at the foot of a non-extension feature file carries
its validator arm there too, or the item falls through to the closing
`return true`; `handleEditorCharacter`'s bare-key `switch` matches in SOURCE
order, so a bare `case "x"` goes BELOW any modified `case "x" where …`; and
`handleEditorKey` refuses while a sheet is attached, because a sheet is
window-modal and the preview panel's forwarded keys would otherwise reach
the key map behind it.

274	        guard !shapes.isEmpty else { return nil }
275	        let shape = shapes[min(max(0, shapePopup.indexOfSelectedItem), shapes.count - 1)]
276	        let speaker = follow.follow == .speaker
277	        return VerticalSettings(
278	            shape: shape, follow: follow.follow, zoom: follow.zoom, whereEmpty: follow.whereEmpty,
279	            mics: speaker ? picker.mics : [], micFaces: speaker ? picker.micFaces : nil)
280	    }

282	    /// Whether Make hands the analysis on: an analysing follow with requests missing.
283	    private func pending(_ follow: FollowSubjectSettings) -> Bool {
284	        VerticalVersion.analyses(follow.follow) && requestError == nil && !requests.isEmpty
285	    }

287	    /// Says what Make would do and enables it: the request error, the pending summary,
288	    /// "Reading the analysis…", or the plan made on main over the document's current handle.
289	    private func refresh() {
290	        let follow = self.follow
291	        let analysing = VerticalVersion.analyses(follow.follow)
292	        let speaker = follow.follow == .speaker
293	        whereEmptyPopup.isEnabled = follow.follow != .center
294	        picker.view.isHidden = !speaker
295	        speakerSubjects = nil
296	        var enabled = false
297	        if let settings = settings(follow) {
298	            let ticked = (2...VerticalSpeakerPicker.mostMicrophones).contains(settings.mics.count)
299	            if analysing, let requestError {
300	                summaryLabel.stringValue = requestError
301	            } else if speaker, let document,
302	                VerticalVersion.speakerClips(document.project, settings: settings, missing: missing)
303	                    .isEmpty
304	            {
305	                summaryLabel.stringValue = VerticalVersion.noSpeakerClipSheet
306	            } else if pending(follow) {
307	                let size = settings.shape.size(from: canvas)
308	                summaryLabel.stringValue = VerticalVersion.pendingSummary(
309	                    files: Set(requests.map(\.media.id)).count, width: size.width,
310	                    height: size.height, speaker: speaker)
311	                enabled = !speaker || ticked
312	            } else if analysing, subjects == nil {
313	                summaryLabel.stringValue = FollowSubjectSheetController.reading
314	            } else if speaker {
315	                switch reading(settings) {
316	                case .refused(let why):
317	                    summaryLabel.stringValue = why
318	                case .ready(let read, _, _):
319	                    // Read again: the reading's first offer may have preset the faces.
320	                    let confirmed = self.settings(follow) ?? settings
321	                    speakerSubjects = read
322	                    let (made, text) = planned(confirmed)
323	                    summaryLabel.stringValue = text
324	                    enabled = made && ticked && confirmed.micFaces != nil
325	                }
326	            } else {
327	                let (made, text) = planned(settings)
328	                summaryLabel.stringValue = text
329	                enabled = made
330	            }
331	        }
332	        makeButton?.isEnabled = enabled
333	        acceptIfAsked()
334	    }

336	    /// VR-66 (c): the ticked set's reading, a ready one cached and offered to the picker at every
337	    /// refresh (`offer` presets a set once, so a repeat does nothing until the set is ticked
338	    /// again and its rows rebuilt); a refused one read again at every refresh.
339	    private func reading(_ settings: VerticalSettings) -> VerticalVersion.SpeakerReading {
340	        let key = settings.mics
341	        if let cached = readings[key] {
342	            if case .ready(_, _, let match) = cached.read { picker.offer(match, mics: cached.mics) }
343	            return cached.read
344	        }
345	        guard let document else { return .refused("") }
346	        var unconfirmed = settings
347	        unconfirmed.micFaces = nil
348	        let read = VerticalVersion.speakerReading(
349	            document: document, project: document.project, settings: unconfirmed,
350	            subjects: subjects ?? [:], missing: missing)
351	        guard case .ready(_, let reference, let match) = read else { return read }
352	        // The reference's own microphones named back as the ticked ones, track by track.
353	        let snapshot = document.project.snapshot
354	        let own = VerticalVersion.speakerClips(
355	            document.project, settings: unconfirmed, missing: missing
356	        ).first { $0.clip == reference }?.mics ?? []
357	        let byTrack = Dictionary(
358	            key.compactMap { id in snapshot.clip(id).map { ($0.track, id) } },
359	            uniquingKeysWith: { first, _ in first })
360	        let mics = own.map { snapshot.clip($0).flatMap { byTrack[$0.track] } ?? $0 }
361	        readings[key] = (read, mics)
362	        picker.offer(match, mics: mics)
363	        return read
364	    }
365	
366	    /// `VerticalVersion.plan` on the document's current handle: whether it makes anything, and
367	    /// its summary or the refusal.
368	    private func planned(_ settings: VerticalSettings) -> (Bool, String) {
369	        guard let document else { return (false, "") }
370	        do {
371	            let read = settings.follow == .speaker
372	                ? (speakerSubjects ?? [:])
373	                : VerticalVersion.analyses(settings.follow) ? (subjects ?? [:]) : [:]
374	            switch try VerticalVersion.plan(
375	                document.project, settings: settings, subjects: read, missing: missing)
376	            {
377	            case .plan(let plan):
378	                let report = VerticalVersion.templateReport(
379	                    templates, copy: copyBox.state == .on)
380	                return (!plan.ops.isEmpty, VerticalVersion.summary(plan, templates: report))
381	            case .refused(let why): return (false, why)
382	            }
383	        } catch {
384	            return (false, error.localizedDescription)
385	        }
386	    }

388	    /// The dev accept: Make pressed once, async, the first time it is enabled with the sheet up;
389	    /// `in-place` unticks Make a copy first.
390	    private func acceptIfAsked() {
391	        #if FRAMEJOB_DEV_TOOLS
392	        guard makeButton?.isEnabled == true, !accepted, view.window != nil else { return }
393	        let defaults = UserDefaults.standard
394	        let inPlace = defaults.string(forKey: Self.devAcceptKey) == Self.devAcceptInPlace
395	        guard inPlace || defaults.bool(forKey: Self.devAcceptKey) else { return }
396	        accepted = true
397	        if inPlace { copyBox.state = .off }
398	        DispatchQueue.main.async { [weak self] in self?.makeClicked(nil) }
399	        #endif
400	    }

402	    // MARK: - Controls
403	
404	    @objc private func controlChanged(_ sender: Any?) {
405	        refresh()
406	    }
407	
408	    func controlTextDidEndEditing(_ obj: Notification) {
409	        let range = FollowSubjectSettings.zoomRange
410	        let percent = Double(zoomField.integerValue)
411	        zoomField.integerValue = Int(
412	            min(max(percent, range.lowerBound * 100), range.upperBound * 100))
413	        refresh()
414	    }
415	
416	    // MARK: - Commit
417	
418	    @objc private func cancelClicked(_ sender: Any?) {
419	        dismiss(self)
420	    }
421	
422	    /// Writes the remembered keys, dismisses and hands the editor what it needs: the plan is
423	    /// made again there, on the current handle, after the project check (VR-39 (f), (g)).
424	    @objc private func makeClicked(_ sender: Any?) {
425	        guard makeButton?.isEnabled == true, let asked else { return }
426	        let follow = self.follow
427	        guard let settings = settings(follow) else { return }
428	        let following = VerticalVersion.analyses(follow.follow)
429	        let analyzing = pending(follow)
430	        follow.remember(changedFrom: opened, in: .standard)
431	        let read = follow.follow == .speaker ? speakerSubjects : subjects
432	        handOff = VerticalHandOff(
433	            settings: settings, copy: copyBox.state == .on, targets: following ? present : [],
434	            cursor: following ? cursor : [], missing: missing, requests: analyzing ? requests : [],
435	            subjects: analyzing || !following ? [:] : (read ?? [:]), asked: asked,
436	            scope: askedScope)
437	        dismiss(self)
438	    }

3	/// Make Vertical's step (spec §11 VR-30…VR-35; road map "creator-jobs" VR3a): a project's
4	/// tall or square version as one grouped edit — `set_canvas`, a "Backgrounds" track, one
5	/// `reframe_clip` per picture from the old canvas, its backdrops and plates re-filled — tried
6	/// on one `SwitchAngle.Trial`. The copy is `ProjectDocument+VerticalCopy.swift`'s, the tool
7	/// `AgentServer+VerticalVersion.swift`'s; File ▸ Make Vertical Version… is
8	/// `VerticalVersionSheetController.swift` and `EditorViewController+VerticalVersion.swift` (VR3b,
9	/// VR-39).
10	///
11	/// This file holds the shapes (VR-32), the settings and the classes (VR-33);
12	/// `VerticalVersion+Plan.swift` the step (VR-34); `VerticalVersion+Summary.swift` the summary
13	/// and the answer (VR-35, VR-36); `VerticalVersion+Layers.swift` the graphics (VR-42, VR-44,
14	/// VR4b); `VerticalVersion+Layouts.swift` class 2b and step 3b (VR-53, VR-54, VR5b). Swift restates none
15	/// of VR-26's refusals: a clip the core will not frame reaches `keep` through the core's own
16	/// sentence. Names no `rc_*`.
17	enum VerticalShape: String, CaseIterable {
18	    case tall = "9:16"
19	    case portrait = "4:5"
20	    case square = "1:1"
21	
22	    /// Height over width.
23	    private var ratio: Double {
24	        switch self {
25	        case .tall: return 16.0 / 9.0
26	        case .portrait: return 5.0 / 4.0
27	        case .square: return 1
28	        }
29	    }
30	
31	    /// VR-32: w = min(W, H) rounded down to even; h = 2 × round(w × ratio / 2).
32	    func size(from canvas: CanvasSnapshot) -> (width: Int, height: Int) {
33	        let short = min(canvas.width, canvas.height)
34	        let width = short - short % 2
35	        let height = 2 * Int((Double(width) * ratio / 2).rounded())
36	        return (width, height)
37	    }
38	}
39	
40	/// What the step is asked for (VR-36's arguments, VR3b's sheet).
41	struct VerticalSettings: Equatable {
42	    var shape: VerticalShape
43	    /// One of `VerticalVersion.follows`.
44	    var follow: FramingFollow
45	    /// Times the scale that fills the canvas, 1–4 (the core refuses outside).
46	    var zoom: Double
47	    var whereEmpty: FramingWhereEmpty
48	    /// Whether step (6) re-pages the word caption tracks (spec §11 VR-40 (f)); the sheet
49	    /// passes the default, `make_vertical_version` its `captions`.
50	    var captions = true
51	    /// `follow: speaker`'s microphones (spec §11 VR-64 (a)): 2–4 clip ids, each standing for
52	    /// its track; read only with `speaker`.
53	    var mics: [UInt32] = []
54	    /// One face number per microphone in `mics`' order, or nil for the core's own match; read
55	    /// only with `speaker`.
56	    var micFaces: [UInt32]? = nil
57	}
58	
59	enum VerticalVersion {
60	    /// The undo step's name (VR-31, FC-90).
61	    static let actionName = "Make Vertical"
62	    static let backgroundsName = FollowSubject.backgroundsName
63	    /// The name `add_blurred_background` and `reframe_clip`'s backdrop give a copy.
64	    static let blurredName = "Blurred Background"
65	    /// The sheet's Follow pop-up and the tool's `follow`, in order (spec §11 VR-66 (a)): Follow
66	    /// Subject's list with Speaker before Center.
67	    static let follows: [FramingFollow] = [.subject, .face, .person, .salient, .speaker, .center]
68	
69	    /// Whether `follow` analyses the media pictures (VR-64 (c)): the following kinds and
70	    /// `speaker`, which frames its other pictures on their faces.
71	    static func analyses(_ follow: FramingFollow) -> Bool {
72	        follow.follows || follow == .speaker
73	    }
74	
75	    /// The Make Vertical sheet's opening Follow and Where Empty (VR-66 (a)): VR-29 (c)'s key
76	    /// read against `follows`, so a stored `speaker` opens Speaker here while Follow Subject's
77	    /// sheet reads it as Subject; any other value is Subject. Where Empty as
78	    /// `FollowSubjectSettings.remembered`; Zoom is never remembered, so 1.
79	    static func remembered(_ defaults: UserDefaults) -> FollowSubjectSettings {
80	        var settings = FollowSubjectSettings.remembered(defaults, zoom: 1)
81	        let kind = defaults.string(forKey: FollowSubjectSettings.followKey)
82	            .flatMap(FramingFollow.init(rawValue:))
83	        settings.follow = kind.flatMap { follows.contains($0) ? $0 : nil } ?? .subject
84	        return settings
85	    }
86	
87	    /// What the step did to one clip, as the answer spells it.
88	    enum Treatment: String {
89	        case followed, whole, kept, refilled, removed, resized, relaid
90	        case notFollowed = "not_followed"
91	    }
92	
93	    /// VR-33's classes.
94	    enum Role: Equatable {
95	        /// (1) A blurred copy of the clip `partner`, in front of it.
96	        case backdrop(partner: UInt32)
97	        /// (2) A shape rectangle the canvas's size at the centre, scale 1.
98	        case shapePlate
99	        /// (2) An image or still named "Background" at the canvas's fill.
100	        case imagePlate
101	        /// (2b) A clip laid out by Clip ▸ Camera Layout ▸ as the camera, as the screen behind
102	        /// it, or a cut piece of one (VR-53 (a), `VerticalVersion+Layouts.swift`).
103	        case layoutCamera, layoutScreen, layoutPiece
104	        /// (3) A media, still or image clip covering one axis of the canvas.
105	        case picture
106	        /// (4) A nest clip covering one axis.
107	        case nest
108	        /// (5) A graphic exactly the canvas's size, each side (VR-42 (a)).
109	        case graphic
110	        /// (6) Everything else.
111	        case other
112	    }
113	
114	    /// VR-33's first match per top-level clip with a picture (not audio-only, not an
115	    /// adjustment clip, video enabled), in id order, on the OLD canvas.
116	    static func classify(_ project: ReelProject) -> [(clip: UInt32, role: Role)] {
117	        let snapshot = project.snapshot
118	        let order = Dictionary(
119	            uniqueKeysWithValues: snapshot.tracks.enumerated().map { ($0.element.id, $0.offset) })
120	        return snapshot.clips.sorted { $0.id < $1.id }.compactMap { clip in
121	            guard hasPicture(clip, in: snapshot) else { return nil }
122	            return (clip.id, role(of: clip, in: project, order: order))
123	        }
124	    }
125	
126	    /// The `.picture` clips whose source is `.media` (the analysis targets).
127	    static func mediaPictures(
128	        _ roles: [(clip: UInt32, role: Role)], in snapshot: ProjectSnapshot
129	    ) -> [UInt32] {
130	        roles.compactMap { entry in
131	            guard entry.role == .picture, let clip = snapshot.clip(entry.clip),
132	                case .media = clip.source
133	            else { return nil }
134	            return entry.clip
135	        }
136	    }
137	
138	    /// VR-37's analysis targets: the media pictures (`mediaPictures(classify(project), …)`),
139	    /// split by whether their media has a URL in `urls` (`document.mediaURLs()`); `missing` are
140	    /// kept, not followed. A present one whose media has a cursor file is in `cursor`, never
141	    /// analysed: it follows its cursor (spec §11 VR-51). The tool's first hop and the sheet
142	    /// both read it (VR-39 (d)).
143	    static func analysisTargets(_ project: ReelProject, urls: [UInt32: URL])
144	        -> (present: [UInt32], missing: Set<UInt32>, cursor: [UInt32])
145	    {
146	        let snapshot = project.snapshot
147	        let pictures = mediaPictures(classify(project), in: snapshot)
148	        let missing = Set(pictures.filter { id in
149	            snapshot.clip(id)?.source.mediaID.map { urls[$0] == nil } ?? false
150	        })
151	        let found = pictures.filter { !missing.contains($0) }
152	        let cursor = found.filter { id in
153	            snapshot.clip(id).flatMap { snapshot.media(for: $0) }?.cursor != nil
154	        }
155	        return (found.filter { !cursor.contains($0) }, missing, cursor)
156	    }
157	
158	    /// VR-32's "not offered": `VerticalShape.allCases` whose size differs from `canvas`, in case
159	    /// order (the sheet's Shape pop-up, VR-39 (b)).
160	    static func offered(_ canvas: CanvasSnapshot) -> [VerticalShape] {
161	        VerticalShape.allCases.filter { shape in
162	            let size = shape.size(from: canvas)
163	            return size.width != canvas.width || size.height != canvas.height
164	        }
165	    }
166	
167	    /// "moves by its own motion: <name>" for the first active slot that is neither a fade nor
168	    /// a spin, in the order during, in, out; nil when there is none.
169	    static func motionNote(_ clip: ClipSnapshot) -> String? {
170	        guard let motion = clip.videoProps.motion else { return nil }
171	        if let during = motion.during, during.amount > 0, during.kind != .spin {
172	            return "moves by its own motion: \(during.kind.displayName)"
173	        }
174	        for edge in [motion.inEdge, motion.out].compactMap({ $0 })
175	        where edge.isActive && edge.kind != .fade && edge.kind != .spin {
176	            return "moves by its own motion: \(edge.kind.displayName)"
177	        }
178	        return nil
179	    }
180	
181	    /// The scale that fills `canvas` with a source of `size` (`edit_fit.rs`'s `fill_scale`),
182	    /// clamped to the canvas sessions' range.
183	    static func fill(_ size: CGSize, width: Int, height: Int) -> Double {
184	        guard size.width > 0, size.height > 0 else { return 1 }
185	        let scale = max(Double(width) / size.width, Double(height) / size.height)
186	        return min(CanvasScaleSession.maxScale, max(CanvasScaleSession.minScale, scale))
187	    }
188	
189	    // MARK: - The classes
190	
191	    /// A clip that draws pixels: `ProjectSnapshot.layers(at:)`'s test without the time.
192	    private static func hasPicture(_ clip: ClipSnapshot, in snapshot: ProjectSnapshot) -> Bool {
193	        guard clip.enabled.video else { return false }
194	        if case .adjustment = clip.source { return false }
195	        if let media = snapshot.media(for: clip) { return media.hasVideo || media.kind == .image }
196	        return true
197	    }
198	
199	    private static func role(
200	        of clip: ClipSnapshot, in project: ReelProject, order: [UInt32: Int]
201	    ) -> Role {
202	        let snapshot = project.snapshot
203	        let canvas = snapshot.canvas
204	        if clip.name == blurredName, let partner = partner(of: clip, in: snapshot, order: order) {
205	            return .backdrop(partner: partner)
206	        }
207	        let video = clip.videoProps
208	        let centred = abs(video.x) <= 1e-6 && abs(video.y) <= 1e-6
209	        switch clip.source {
210	        case .shape:
211	            if let shape = clip.shape, shape.kind == .rectangle, centred,
212	                abs(video.scale - 1) <= 1e-6,
213	                abs(shape.width - Double(canvas.width)) <= 0.5,
214	                abs(shape.height - Double(canvas.height)) <= 0.5
215	            {
216	                return .shapePlate
217	            }
218	        case .image, .still:
219	            if clip.name == "Background", centred, let size = snapshot.sourceSize(of: clip) {
220	                let fill = fill(size, width: canvas.width, height: canvas.height)
221	                if abs(video.scale - fill) <= 1e-6 * fill { return .imagePlate }
222	            }
223	        case .graphic:
224	            if let graphic = clip.graphic, graphic.width == canvas.width,
225	                graphic.height == canvas.height
226	            {
227	                return .graphic
228	            }
229	        default:
230	            break
231	        }
232	        if let laid = layoutRole(of: clip, in: snapshot, order: order) { return laid }
233	        switch clip.source {
234	        case .media, .still, .image:
235	            if covers(clip, in: project) { return .picture }
236	        case .nest:
237	            if covers(clip, in: project) { return .nest }
238	        default:
239	            break
240	        }
241	        return .other
242	    }
243	
244	    /// (1)'s partner: a clip on a track in front of `clip`'s with an equal source, start and
245	    /// duration; the nearest track first.
246	    private static func partner(
247	        of clip: ClipSnapshot, in snapshot: ProjectSnapshot, order: [UInt32: Int]
248	    ) -> UInt32? {
249	        guard let own = order[clip.track] else { return nil }
250	        return snapshot.clips
251	            .filter {
252	                $0.id != clip.id && (order[$0.track] ?? -1) > own && $0.source == clip.source
253	                    && $0.start == clip.start && $0.duration == clip.duration
254	            }
255	            .min { (order[$0.track] ?? 0, $0.id) < (order[$1.track] ?? 0, $1.id) }?.id
256	    }
257	
258	    /// (3)'s test: the clip's rectangle at its first frame — base props with scale, x and y
259	    /// from `clip_state` at its start — covers one axis of the canvas (both edges at or beyond
260	    /// it, at most 1 px inside) and is centred within 2 % on the other, or covers it too.
261	    private static func covers(_ clip: ClipSnapshot, in project: ReelProject) -> Bool {
262	        let snapshot = project.snapshot
263	        guard let size = snapshot.sourceSize(of: clip) else { return false }
264	        var video = clip.videoProps
265	        if let state = project.clipState(clip.id, at: clip.start)?["video"] as? [String: Any] {
266	            if let scale = (state["scale"] as? NSNumber)?.doubleValue { video.scale = scale }
267	            if let x = (state["x"] as? NSNumber)?.doubleValue { video.x = x }
268	            if let y = (state["y"] as? NSNumber)?.doubleValue { video.y = y }
269	        }
270	        let canvas = snapshot.canvas
271	        let rect = canvasRect(of: clip, in: canvas, sourceSize: size, video: video)
272	        let (w, h) = (Double(canvas.width), Double(canvas.height))
273	        let coversX = rect.minX <= 1 && rect.maxX >= w - 1
274	        let coversY = rect.minY <= 1 && rect.maxY >= h - 1
275	        let centredX = abs(rect.midX - w / 2) <= 0.02 * w
276	        let centredY = abs(rect.midY - h / 2) <= 0.02 * h
277	        return (coversX && (centredY || coversY)) || (coversY && centredX)
278	    }
279	}

# app/CLAUDE.md — Swift app rules

Applies to everything under `app/`. Build/verification commands and the FFI
lockstep are in the root `CLAUDE.md`; the full design is
`designs/spec/` (§3–4 the UI, §7.4–7.8 the platform side; its `README.md` is
the index). The
long form of each entry below — why each file is the shape it is, and the
traps its history turned up — is `designs/adr/app-file-history.md` (the
full history, every size toll and measurement, is archived; see its
"Original" line); this file is what governs a file now. Files
are listed by family; a file with a header comment of its own carries its
detail there.

## File map

**The core's edge.**
- `ReelCore.swift` — with its `ReelCore+<Area>.swift` files, the only files
  that call `rc_*` (spec §11 CJ-8 (l)); a new wrapper goes in the file of its
  area. `ReelCore.swift` holds `ReelProject`
  (handle + lazily decoded `ProjectSnapshot`; `json`, `snapshot` and
  `planJSON` are memoised PER HANDLE, so keep handles rather than minting
  them; so is `sourceMap(_:)`, `rc_project_source_map` decoded and checked
  once per handle and clip, SR-20), timecode, snapping (export presets/sizes/settings are
  `ExportValues.swift`'s, a pure move, HDR H-1), `ReelSpeed.limits` (the
  core's speed range and audio ceiling, typed as `SpeedLimits` in
  `CoreValues.swift` — no Swift file types a speed bound), `ReelColor` (`rc_normalise_color`, G-25) and `ReelAgentSocket` (below);
  `ReelCore+MediaFiles.swift` holds the media files the core reads or writes —
  `ReelContainer` (`rc_container_*`, a WebM/Matroska file's index, #216-R), `ReelCube`,
  `ReelHDR10` (`rc_hdr10_peak`, spec §11 HD-6; `av1Peak`, `rc_hdr10_av1_peak`, HD-18;
  `stillPeak`, `rc_hdr10_still_peak`, HD-20), `ReelAV1` and `ReelWebM` (`rc_webm_*`, the
  `av1_webm` writer, spec §11 CX-15) — `ReelCore+Cursor.swift` holds `ReelCursor`
  (`rc_cursor_open`, `rc_cursor_free`: a cursor file's open, which is its check, spec
  §11 CU-9, CU-15; road map creator-jobs CU1a; and `query`, `rc_cursor_query`'s one
  JSON request, CU2, spec §11 CU-25, and the static `query(_:tracks:project:)`, the
  same call over n tracks with a project (`plan_zooms`, CU-70)) — `ReelCore+Framing.swift`
  holds `SpeakerMatch` and `ReelProject.speakerMatch` (`rc_project_speaker_match`, road map
  creator-jobs VR6b, spec §11 VR-65: the face-to-microphone match Make Vertical's sheet

**Frozen files.** `EditorViewController.swift`, `TimelineView.swift`,
`PreviewCanvasView.swift`, `AgentServer.swift` are **frozen at current
size**: anything adding more than ~50 lines goes in an extension file
(`EditorViewController+<Feature>.swift`, `TimelineView+<Feature>.swift`,
`AgentServer+<Feature>.swift`) or a new `…SheetController`, and the frozen
file keeps only the wiring — a stored property, a closure assignment, a
validator arm, a draw call. The pieces extension files build on are therefore
internal, not private. Pitfalls: a selector declared `@objc` on an extension
needs NO forward in the frozen file (a second declaration is an error); a
command whose body sits at the foot of a non-extension feature file carries
its validator arm there too, or the item falls through to the closing
`return true`; `handleEditorCharacter`'s bare-key `switch` matches in SOURCE
order, so a bare `case "x"` goes BELOW any modified `case "x" where …`; and
`handleEditorKey` refuses while a sheet is attached, because a sheet is
window-modal and the preview panel's forwarded keys would otherwise reach
the key map behind it.

1	import AppKit
2	
3	/// The Make Vertical Version sheet's Microphones and Faces block, shown with Follow Speaker (road
4	/// map "creator-jobs" VR6b, spec §11 VR-66 (b), (d)): one checkbox per microphone track (the
5	/// first four ticked unless the sheet is restored with its own), one row per ticked microphone
6	/// with a Face pop-up, and a muted note. It shows the core's match (`offer`) and never computes
7	/// one: a sure match presets the pop-ups to its assignment, once per ticked set; a match that is
8	/// not sure, or none, leaves each on "Choose a face". `micFaces` is nil until every ticked
9	/// microphone has a face of its own. Names no `rc_*`.
10	final class VerticalSpeakerPicker: NSObject {
11	    static let chooseTitle = "Choose a face"
12	    static let sureNote =
13	        "Each microphone is matched to the face that talks with it; change one if it is wrong."
14	    static let unsureNote =
15	        "The faces do not show clearly who is on each microphone: choose each microphone's face."
16	    /// The most microphones `follow: speaker` takes (VR-60 (a)).
17	    static let mostMicrophones = 4
18	
19	    let view: NSView
20	    private let microphones: [VerticalVersion.Microphone]
21	    private let onChange: () -> Void
22	    private var boxes: [NSButton] = []
23	    private let facesColumn = sheetColumn([])
24	    private let note = NSTextField(wrappingLabelWithString: "")
25	    /// The faces' pop-ups, one per ticked microphone, in `mics`' order.
26	    private var popups: [NSPopUpButton] = []
27	    /// The faces the pop-ups list, after "Choose a face".
28	    private var faces: [SpeakerMatch.Face] = []
29	    /// The ticked set the pop-ups were last offered a match for.
30	    private var offeredFor: [UInt32]?
31	
32	    init(
33	        microphones: [VerticalVersion.Microphone], ticked: [UInt32]?,
34	        onChange: @escaping () -> Void
35	    ) {
36	        self.microphones = microphones
37	        self.onChange = onChange
38	        let column = sheetColumn([])
39	        column.spacing = 4
40	        let grid = makeSheetGrid([
41	            [fieldLabel("Microphones:"), column],
42	            [fieldLabel("Faces:"), facesColumn],
43	            [NSGridCell.emptyContentView, note],
44	        ])
45	        grid.row(at: 0).yPlacement = .top
46	        grid.row(at: 1).yPlacement = .top
47	        view = grid
48	        super.init()
49	        for (n, microphone) in microphones.enumerated() {
50	            let box = NSButton(
51	                checkboxWithTitle: microphone.name, target: self,
52	                action: #selector(tickChanged(_:)))
53	            box.font = DS.sans(13)
54	            box.state =
55	                (ticked.map { $0.contains(microphone.clip) } ?? (n < Self.mostMicrophones))
56	                ? .on : .off
57	            box.setAccessibilityIdentifier("vertical.mic.\(microphone.track)")
58	            boxes.append(box)
59	            column.addArrangedSubview(box)
60	        }
61	        facesColumn.spacing = 6
62	        note.font = DS.sans(12)
63	        note.textColor = DS.textMuted
64	        note.preferredMaxLayoutWidth = sheetWidth - sheetInset * 2 - 118
65	        note.setAccessibilityIdentifier("vertical.speakerNote")
66	        rebuildRows()
67	    }
68	
69	    /// The ticked microphones' clips, front to back.
70	    var mics: [UInt32] {
71	        zip(microphones, boxes).filter { $0.1.state == .on }.map(\.0.clip)
72	    }
73	
74	    /// One face number per ticked microphone, in `mics`' order; nil until each has a face and
75	    /// no two share one.
76	    var micFaces: [UInt32]? {
77	        var chosen: [UInt32] = []
78	        for popup in popups {
79	            let index = popup.indexOfSelectedItem
80	            guard index >= 1, index - 1 < faces.count else { return nil }
81	            chosen.append(faces[index - 1].face)
82	        }
83	        guard !chosen.isEmpty, Set(chosen).count == chosen.count else { return nil }
84	        return chosen
85	    }
86	
87	    /// The core's match for the ticked set: `mics` names, per entry of its `assignment`, the
88	    /// ticked microphone it is for. The pop-ups list its faces; a sure match presets them, and a
89	    /// set is preset once, so a person's choice stands through every later refresh.
90	    func offer(_ match: SpeakerMatch?, mics assigned: [UInt32]) {
91	        let ticked = mics
92	        guard offeredFor != ticked else { return }
93	        offeredFor = ticked
94	        faces = match?.faces ?? []
95	        for popup in popups { fill(popup) }
96	        if let match, match.sure {
97	            for (n, mic) in assigned.enumerated() where n < match.assignment.count {
98	                guard let row = ticked.firstIndex(of: mic),
99	                    let face = faces.firstIndex(where: { $0.face == match.assignment[n] })
100	                else { continue }
101	                popups[row].selectItem(at: face + 1)
102	            }
103	            note.stringValue = Self.sureNote
104	        } else {
105	            note.stringValue = Self.unsureNote
106	        }
107	    }
108	
109	    // MARK: - Rows
110	
111	    @objc private func tickChanged(_ sender: Any?) {
112	        rebuildRows()
113	        onChange()
114	    }
115	
116	    @objc private func faceChanged(_ sender: Any?) {
117	        onChange()
118	    }
119	
120	    /// One Faces row per ticked microphone, each on "Choose a face" until the next `offer`.
121	    private func rebuildRows() {
122	        for row in facesColumn.arrangedSubviews {
123	            facesColumn.removeArrangedSubview(row)
124	            row.removeFromSuperview()
125	        }
126	        popups = []
127	        faces = []
128	        offeredFor = nil
129	        note.stringValue = ""
130	        for (microphone, box) in zip(microphones, boxes) where box.state == .on {
131	            let name = NSTextField(labelWithString: microphone.name)
132	            name.font = DS.sans(13)
133	            name.textColor = DS.textStrong
134	            name.widthAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: 96).isActive = true
135	            name.lineBreakMode = .byTruncatingTail
136	            let popup = NSPopUpButton(frame: .zero, pullsDown: false)
137	            popup.font = DS.sans(13)
138	            popup.target = self
139	            popup.action = #selector(faceChanged(_:))
140	            popup.setAccessibilityIdentifier("vertical.face.\(microphone.track)")
141	            fill(popup)
142	            popups.append(popup)
143	            facesColumn.addArrangedSubview(sheetRow([name, popup]))
144	        }
145	    }
146	
147	    /// "Choose a face", then "Face N (X % across)" per face found, on "Choose a face".
148	    private func fill(_ popup: NSPopUpButton) {
149	        popup.removeAllItems()
150	        popup.addItem(withTitle: Self.chooseTitle)
151	        for face in faces {
152	            popup.addItem(withTitle: "Face \(face.face) (\(Int((face.x * 100).rounded())) % across)")
153	        }
154	        popup.selectItem(at: 0)
155	    }

1	import AppKit
2	
3	/// The Make Vertical Version sheet's Microphones and Faces block, shown with Follow Speaker (road
4	/// map "creator-jobs" VR6b, spec §11 VR-66 (b), (d)): one checkbox per microphone track (the
5	/// first four ticked unless the sheet is restored with its own), one row per ticked microphone
6	/// with a Face pop-up, and a muted note. It shows the core's match (`offer`) and never computes
7	/// one: a sure match presets the pop-ups to its assignment, once per ticked set; a match that is
8	/// not sure, or none, leaves each on "Choose a face". `micFaces` is nil until every ticked
9	/// microphone has a face of its own. Names no `rc_*`.
10	final class VerticalSpeakerPicker: NSObject {
11	    static let chooseTitle = "Choose a face"
12	    static let sureNote =
13	        "Each microphone is matched to the face that talks with it; change one if it is wrong."
14	    static let unsureNote =
15	        "The faces do not show clearly who is on each microphone: choose each microphone's face."
16	    /// The most microphones `follow: speaker` takes (VR-60 (a)).
17	    static let mostMicrophones = 4
18	
19	    let view: NSView
20	    private let microphones: [VerticalVersion.Microphone]
21	    private let onChange: () -> Void
22	    private var boxes: [NSButton] = []
23	    private let facesColumn = sheetColumn([])
24	    private let note = NSTextField(wrappingLabelWithString: "")
25	    /// The faces' pop-ups, one per ticked microphone, in `mics`' order.
26	    private var popups: [NSPopUpButton] = []
27	    /// The faces the pop-ups list, after "Choose a face".
28	    private var faces: [SpeakerMatch.Face] = []
29	    /// The ticked set the pop-ups were last offered a match for.
30	    private var offeredFor: [UInt32]?
31	
32	    init(
33	        microphones: [VerticalVersion.Microphone], ticked: [UInt32]?,
34	        onChange: @escaping () -> Void
35	    ) {
36	        self.microphones = microphones
37	        self.onChange = onChange
38	        let column = sheetColumn([])
39	        column.spacing = 4
40	        let grid = makeSheetGrid([
41	            [fieldLabel("Microphones:"), column],
42	            [fieldLabel("Faces:"), facesColumn],
43	            [NSGridCell.emptyContentView, note],
44	        ])
45	        grid.row(at: 0).yPlacement = .top
46	        grid.row(at: 1).yPlacement = .top
47	        view = grid
48	        super.init()
49	        for (n, microphone) in microphones.enumerated() {
50	            let box = NSButton(
51	                checkboxWithTitle: microphone.name, target: self,
52	                action: #selector(tickChanged(_:)))
53	            box.font = DS.sans(13)
54	            box.state =
55	                (ticked.map { $0.contains(microphone.clip) } ?? (n < Self.mostMicrophones))
56	                ? .on : .off
57	            box.setAccessibilityIdentifier("vertical.mic.\(microphone.track)")
58	            boxes.append(box)
59	            column.addArrangedSubview(box)
60	        }
61	        facesColumn.spacing = 6
62	        note.font = DS.sans(12)
63	        note.textColor = DS.textMuted
64	        note.preferredMaxLayoutWidth = sheetWidth - sheetInset * 2 - 118
65	        note.setAccessibilityIdentifier("vertical.speakerNote")
66	        rebuildRows()
67	    }
68	
69	    /// The ticked microphones' clips, front to back.
70	    var mics: [UInt32] {
71	        zip(microphones, boxes).filter { $0.1.state == .on }.map(\.0.clip)
72	    }
73	
74	    /// One face number per ticked microphone, in `mics`' order; nil until each has a face and
75	    /// no two share one.
76	    var micFaces: [UInt32]? {
77	        var chosen: [UInt32] = []
78	        for popup in popups {
79	            let index = popup.indexOfSelectedItem
80	            guard index >= 1, index - 1 < faces.count else { return nil }
81	            chosen.append(faces[index - 1].face)
82	        }
83	        guard !chosen.isEmpty, Set(chosen).count == chosen.count else { return nil }
84	        return chosen
85	    }
86	
87	    /// The core's match for the ticked set: `mics` names, per entry of its `assignment`, the
88	    /// ticked microphone it is for. The pop-ups list its faces; a sure match presets them, and a
89	    /// set is preset once, so a person's choice stands through every later refresh.
90	    func offer(_ match: SpeakerMatch?, mics assigned: [UInt32]) {
91	        let ticked = mics
92	        guard offeredFor != ticked else { return }
93	        offeredFor = ticked
94	        faces = match?.faces ?? []
95	        for popup in popups { fill(popup) }
96	        if let match, match.sure {
97	            for (n, mic) in assigned.enumerated() where n < match.assignment.count {
98	                guard let row = ticked.firstIndex(of: mic),
99	                    let face = faces.firstIndex(where: { $0.face == match.assignment[n] })
100	                else { continue }
101	                popups[row].selectItem(at: face + 1)
102	            }
103	            note.stringValue = Self.sureNote
104	        } else {
105	            note.stringValue = Self.unsureNote
106	        }
107	    }
108	
109	    // MARK: - Rows
110	
111	    @objc private func tickChanged(_ sender: Any?) {
112	        rebuildRows()
113	        onChange()
114	    }
115	
116	    @objc private func faceChanged(_ sender: Any?) {
117	        onChange()
118	    }
119	
120	    /// One Faces row per ticked microphone, each on "Choose a face" until the next `offer`.
121	    private func rebuildRows() {
122	        for row in facesColumn.arrangedSubviews {
123	            facesColumn.removeArrangedSubview(row)
124	            row.removeFromSuperview()
125	        }
126	        popups = []
127	        faces = []
128	        offeredFor = nil
129	        note.stringValue = ""
130	        for (microphone, box) in zip(microphones, boxes) where box.state == .on {
131	            let name = NSTextField(labelWithString: microphone.name)
132	            name.font = DS.sans(13)
133	            name.textColor = DS.textStrong
134	            name.widthAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: 96).isActive = true
135	            name.lineBreakMode = .byTruncatingTail
136	            let popup = NSPopUpButton(frame: .zero, pullsDown: false)
137	            popup.font = DS.sans(13)
138	            popup.target = self
139	            popup.action = #selector(faceChanged(_:))
140	            popup.setAccessibilityIdentifier("vertical.face.\(microphone.track)")
141	            fill(popup)
142	            popups.append(popup)
143	            facesColumn.addArrangedSubview(sheetRow([name, popup]))
144	        }
145	    }
146	
147	    /// "Choose a face", then "Face N (X % across)" per face found, on "Choose a face".
148	    private func fill(_ popup: NSPopUpButton) {
149	        popup.removeAllItems()
150	        popup.addItem(withTitle: Self.chooseTitle)
151	        for face in faces {
152	            popup.addItem(withTitle: "Face \(face.face) (\(Int((face.x * 100).rounded())) % across)")
153	        }
154	        popup.selectItem(at: 0)
155	    }
156	}
